figures.caption: C3 — the necessary-but-not-sufficient asymmetry, cross-family robust. On Mistral-7B and Gemma-2-9B, path-patching the identified shortlist restores logit-diff (necessity ✓, 0.955 and 1.018); reinserting only the shortlist while resample-ablating the rest recovers almost nothing (sufficiency ✗, 0.113 and 0.019). The verify PASS (robustness = 1.0) is on this asymmetry.

C3 — full recovery-metric comparison across necessity + sufficiency + models. LD (logit-diff) and PD (prob-diff) tell a consistent story; KL suffers a denominator-collapse artifact on the anchor cell (baseline KL(clean||corrupt) = 0.043) so is de-emphasised.
